chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from Abū al-Faḍl al-Shahbānī, from Hārūn ibn al-Faḍl, who said:
I saw Abū al-Ḥasan ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad عليه السلام on the day in which Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام passed away.
So he said: “Indeed we belong to Allah, and indeed to Him we shall return.”
Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام has passed away.
So it was said to him: “And how did you know?”
He said: “Because a humbleness before Allah entered into me that I had not known before.”

key_terms.إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُ: Quranic declaration of belonging to Allah and returning to Him at loss and death
key_terms.تُدَاخِلُنِي: entered into me; came over me inwardly
key_terms.تُوُفِّيَ: passed away; was taken in death
key_terms.مَضَى: has passed away; has gone on

ai.seo_question: How did Imam ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad عليه السلام know that Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام had passed away?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that Imam ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad عليه السلام became aware of the passing of Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام through an inward state of humbleness before Allah. It reflects a theological dimension of the Imam’s awareness and links that awareness with submission to Allah and recognition of divine decree.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Abu Al Fazal Al Shahbany, from Haroun Bin Al Fazl who said,

‘I saw Abu Al-Hassan Ali Bin Muhammad<sup>asws</sup> (10<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>) during the day in which Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> (9<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>) passed away, and he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘We are for Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and to Him<sup>azwj</sup> we are returning’. Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> has passed away’. So it was said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘And how did you<sup>asws</sup> know that?’
He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Because such humbleness to Allah<sup>azwj</sup> entered into me<sup>asws</sup> which I<sup>asws</sup> had not recognised it (beforehand)’.
en.sarwar: 5. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from abu al-Fadl al-Shahbani from Harun ibn al-Fadl who has said the following.
“I saw abu al-Hassan Ali ibn Muhammad on the day abu Ja‘far (a.s.) passed away.
He said, “To Allah we belong and to Him we return.
He was asked, “How do you know that he passed away?”
He said, “A form of humbleness before Allah that I had never experienced overwhelmed me.”
